prerequisites: Portal enabled for helix.example on the owned lab; Jonas Weber and Amara Nwosu in separate browser contexts, each signed in with a fresh link from the lab Mailpit.

API fixtures (fixtures.json): Amara's Request; Jonas's Request converted to a Contract with a Document, Counterparty, Value and dates; an archived Contract on Jonas's team; a Matter without Jonas; 26 Contracts with Jonas on the team for Show more.

Fresh fictional Business User addresses for first visit, expiry, password, two-factor and single sign-on checks; a partner-firm.example account turned into a Business User; Daniel Okafor as the Administrator who changes Business settings, in his own browser context or API session; the two-issuer OIDC fixture; a no-email deployment phase.
scenarios.expected: Only the intended Business User session opens; the portal shows that person's Requests. An unapproved domain gets the supported refusal/neutral response; a bad link offers a working recovery route.
scenarios.actual: 32 recorded Business User steps passed. /portal opened /portal/login with Business Portal sign-in and Helix Software Group first (no logo saved); with a saved logo the page showed one Organization logo image. The page showed a password form; Email me a sign-in link changed it to Get a sign-in link; Email and Send link showed Check your email (If <address> is eligible, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 5 minutes and works once.). The link (5-minute lifetime) opened Welcome to your Business Portal; Department with Continue (no Skip), Skip on later steps and Finish opened /portal. An address outside the allowed domains with no account got the same Check your email and no mail; an existing partner-firm.example Business User got a link that opened the Portal. Sign out in the Portal header returned to /portal/login. The used link opened Sign-in link expired with Email and Send link; the new link opened /portal once; an altered token gave the same recovery page. Jonas saw his own Request R-13 and not Amara's; Amara's Request address and /inbox, /contracts, /matters stayed in the Portal. Your Contracts showed 25 rows and Show more 29; the archived team Contract was not listed and its address said Contract not found. C-34 showed Counterparty, Stage, owners, Term type, dates, Value, the Primary Document label, the current Version on name click and a download; Your Contracts returned to the list. Matters showed M-4 with Matter Type, Status, Matter Manager and Business Owner, not the Matter without Jonas. Record pages showed Fields, Documents, Original request and the Comments, History and Contract team or Matter team applets. The converted Request address redirected to C-34 with Jonas as Business Owner; a new Business Owner joined the team and Jonas stayed a member. Amara in her own context saw only her Request. A link requested five minutes earlier opened Sign-in link expired; Send link gave a new link that worked once. With links off: no Email me a sign-in link; password setup (one hour) and Email, Password, Sign in opened the Portal; Sign-in link expired showed only Back to sign-in. With Portal two-factor required, a link opened the authenticator setup before the Portal, and a later link and a password sign-in asked for a code or setup. With one identity provider: Continue with single sign-on plus Email me a sign-in link, which opened Get a sign-in link; single sign-on opened the Portal as Jonas. With two providers: an Email field above Continue with single sign-on; Email me a sign-in link still led to Get a sign-in link and a working link; with links off, Jonas's address opened http://oidc:8080 and the Portal; unlisted.example showed No single sign-on provider is set up for unlisted.example. Check the address or contact your administrator.; Sign in with a password, then Set up or reset your password and Send password setup link, set a password that signed in. When Daniel removed the last allowed domain, every Business method turned off, the page showed only Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator., and an existing account's earlier link gave no session; after Daniel added helix.example and turned Email magic link back on, that account signed in with a new link. With no email relay the page had no Email me a sign-in link and Sign-in link expired offered only Back to sign-in.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Owned lab accs (openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-accs), created for this seat from 4ca41822b685a2a1e58a38b4f25e421cf735c54e with lab.mjs (app 127.0.0.1:43357, mail 48457, subnets 10.243.57.0/24 and 10.244.57.0/24), Helix seed light profile, random seed 7, seeded 2026-09-28T07:21:50.673Z. Every organization-wide change (identity providers, allowed domains, sign-in methods, required two-factor, logo, email relay) was made on this lab only and put back; the lab was destroyed afterwards. The shared work lab was not used. The lab runs with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off, but the lockouts and email budgets are database counters and were observed.

Identity providers were a local OpenID Connect fixture (oauth2-mock-server 9.2.0, DOC-032/admin-org/oidc-fixture.mjs) with two issuers, http://oidc:8080 and http://oidc:8082, beside the lab (overlay-oidc.json). No vendor identity provider was used; the fixture asserts the fictional identity the script selects.

The unapproved-domain negative check was observed while helix.example was listed (neutral Check your email, no mail). With the list empty the page shows Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator. instead, as the guide now says; that state was walked with an existing Business User and a domain and method were restored.

Product behavior recorded, not a guide error: removing the last allowed domain turns off every Business method and locks out existing Business Users (the defect the author and the admin-org seat recorded). Adding the domain back does not turn a method on; the Administrator must also turn one on, which matches the guide's Ask Legal to add a domain and turn a sign-in method back on.

A Legal Team Member (Nadia Haddad) who followed a Portal sign-in link kept the legal_team_member role and could open /contracts; recorded in walkthrough.json as a supporting step, not a registry role for V-C02.
The Portal Contracts and Matters sections were walked with API fixtures; the Version pill the triage lists is not described by the guide and was not checked.
